title: Al Fakher Crown Bar Mega Max 40K Disposable Vape
body_html: Introducing the Al Fakher 40K, a disposable vape made for those who don't want to be reaching for a new device every other day. It's loaded with an impressive 40,000-puff lifespan and a generous 30ml e-liquid tank, keeping the flavor consistent for weeks on end. Inside, a dual mesh coil works to keep every pull smooth and full-bodied, while adjustable airflow gives you the freedom to switch between a tighter MTL draw and a bigger DTL cloud on demand.
